newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.004pts to 102.840.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.004pts to 102.840.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.004 points in Friday's trading to 102.840, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.274 years.
The index can also be found on Reuters page .BICS.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.070 points to 99.279 points, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.220 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.409 points to 1,052.633.
